instruction: Set up a keyboard shortcut in VS Code to reopen the most recently closed editor tab with 'ctrl+shift+t' when the terminal is active.

metadata.explanation: This task requires setting up a VSCode keybinding that reopens the last closed editor using 'ctrl+shift+t' when the terminal has focus. The evaluator checks if the keybindings.json file contains the expected configuration with key='ctrl+shift+t', command='workbench.action.reopenClosedEditor', and when='terminalFocus'.
